_comment: Story 1-3. Opening hours. Authoritative source: the reconciliation § E.2 table,
⚠️ NINE RANGES, NOT SEVEN. Tuesday and Thursday each emit TWO entries around a
14:00-16:30 break. Publishing those days as a flat 08:00-20:00 would send
someone to a locked door at 3pm — the exact failure this data exists to prevent,
just introduced from the other direction. Any implementation producing seven
entries has silently dropped the break and must fail review.
scripts/check-data.mjs asserts the count and the split days by name.
These values also correct three errors currently live on the Google Business
Profile: Wednesday closes 17:30 (profile said 19:00), Saturday closes 14:30
Times are local (Australia/Sydney) and 24-hour, matching schema.org's
openingHoursSpecification format so 1-5 can emit them without transformation.
Story 1-9 may later pull these from Cliniko's ROSTER (never its availability —
a booked-out hour and an unrostered hour look identical in slot data).
